name: Marked Section Depends on the Initial Term Order
definition: In $k[a_0,a_1,b_0,b_1]$, take the coordinate-bigraded ideal $F=(a_0b_0-a_1b_1)$ and mark $b=0$.
properties: The ideal has the rank-one maximum Hilbert series and $(F:b_0)\cap k[a_0,a_1]=0$, prescribing the full visible one-cube. An order placing the opposite literal $b_1$ first gives initial ideal $(a_1b_1)$ and preserves that section. Choosing leading term $a_0b_0$ instead gives a singleton section. The starting paired differences need not be regular: after $a_0=a_1$, the factor $b_0-b_1$ is a zero divisor.
